summary: Master the art of nonverbal communication through our comprehensive body language training course. Improve your interpersonal skills and understanding.
lede: A body language course helps professionals who lead, facilitate, interview or sell observe nonverbal cues in workplace conversations. Learners practise separating visible behavior from assumptions, reviewing posture, facial movement and vocal delivery, and adapting their approach in meetings or difficult discussions; they also use spoken clarification and consent-aware observation to check interpretations rather than treating cues as proof of emotion.
audienceIntro: Body Language and Nonverbal Communication Training suits professionals who influence decisions, guide conversations, or interpret interaction patterns in daily work. It is appropriate for foundation to intermediate learners and does not require prior study in psychology or communication research.
prerequisites: No formal qualification in psychology, communication, or human resources is required. You should bring workplace experience involving meetings, presentations, interviews, coaching, customer conversations, or stakeholder engagement. Coding is not required. A laptop with a camera and audio capability is useful for optional self-recording activities, and all recordings should follow your organization’s consent and privacy requirements.
